if not value or not value.get('performanceEventId'): return "This speed loss has ended, or someone's event covers it."
	pattern = system.kanoa.date.localizeDateFormat('MMM d, h:mm a', self.session.props.locale)
	text = "Below the standard rate since %s: %s minutes of output lost%s." % (
		system.date.format(value['startDate'], pattern), system.kanoa.utilities.formatNumber('#,##0.#', value['value'] or 0),
		' so far' if value['isActive'] else '')
	text += " Reason: %s%s." % (value['performanceStateName'], ' (set by the system: pick the real reason)' if value['autoReason'] else '')
	return text

config.script:
event = self.view.custom.event
	reason = self.view.custom.selected.reason
	try:
		eventId = event['performanceEventId']
	except:
		eventId = None
	if eventId is None or reason is None:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Pick a reason'})
		return
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	# A guest has no user (-1): saving would fail on the database with a confusing message
	if userId is None or userId < 0:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'speedLossLogIn', 'type': 'warning', 'message': system.util.translate('Log in to set a speed loss reason', self.session.props.locale)})
		return
	result, msg = system.kanoa.event.setPerformanceReason(eventId, reason, self.view.custom.selected.note or None, userId)
	if msg:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'autoClose': 0, 'message': "Couldn't save reason: %s" % msg})
		return
	#The popup closes, so no success toast
	system.perspective.sendMessage('perfEventsUpdated', {})
	system.perspective.closePopup('speedLossReason')
	return

#Gives the event back to the reason the system gives it (Unassigned, or Positions blocked), as if none had been picked (868mu2fkx)
	try:
		eventId = self.view.custom.event['performanceEventId']
	except:
		eventId = None
	if eventId is None: return
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	# A guest has no user (-1): saving would fail on the database with a confusing message
	if userId is None or userId < 0:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'speedLossLogIn', 'type': 'warning', 'message': system.util.translate('Log in to clear a speed loss reason', self.session.props.locale)})
		return
	result, msg = system.kanoa.event.setPerformanceReason(eventId, None, None, userId)
	if msg:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'autoClose': 0, 'message': "Couldn't clear reason: %s" % msg})
		return
	system.perspective.sendMessage('perfEventsUpdated', {})
	system.perspective.closePopup('speedLossReason')
	return

messageHandlers.script:
if payload.get('msgHandler') != 'speedLossReasonSelected': return
	#The tree sends its empty selection as it loads: keep the reason already set (a pick, or the event's own)
	if not payload['selection']: return
	#A reason class isn't a reason: only a leaf can be picked
	selection = payload['selection'][0]['value'] if payload['selection'] else None
	reasonId = selection.get('performanceStateId') if selection else None
	self.view.custom.selected.reason = reasonId
	self.view.custom.selected.reasonPath = selection.get('performanceStatePath') if reasonId is not None else None
	return
